name: interviewly
description: Mock interviews about your own code. Interviewly reads your CV and your projects, asks the follow-ups real interviewers ask, checks every CV claim, and turns code you vibe coded into 10-minute lessons. You built it. Now explain it.

interface.shortDescription: You built it. Now explain it.
interface.longDescription: Give Interviewly your CV and a job ad. It reads your projects, predicts the questions you'll get, asks follow-ups like a real interviewer, checks every CV claim against your code, and turns the parts you vibe coded into 10-minute lessons, until you can explain every line.
defaultPrompt: Help me prepare for this job: <paste the job description>
Quiz me on my project like a real interviewer
